title: Unity 6 API Conventions & Deprecations
summary: Critical Unity 6 changes: Rigidbody2D.linearVelocity replaces .velocity; SceneManager.CreateScene in Play Mode vs EditorSceneManager.NewScene in Edit Mode.
content:
# Unity 6 API Conventions & Deprecations

## 1. Rigidbody2D.velocity -> Rigidbody2D.linearVelocity
- Unity 6 deprecated `rb.velocity` and `rb.angularVelocity`.
- Always use `rb.linearVelocity`.

## 2. Scene Dirtying
- Always call `UnityEditor.SceneManagement.EditorSceneManager.MarkSceneDirty(scene)` after procedural generation so Ctrl+S or Editor save persists changes.

## 3. LevelBuilder MenuItem Placement
- Place in `Assets/Scripts/Editor/LevelBuilder.cs` inside `[MenuItem("Tools/Build Super Mario Level 1")]`.
- Must be in an `Editor` folder so it compiles only in the Unity Editor assembly.
